boundaries.processing: mapshaper weighted 8% keep-shapes, precision=0.00001; D3 spherical winding normalization
boundaries.limitations: Historical census boundaries, not current legal administrative divisions. Simplified display geometry.

hierarchy.processing: Topological union of actual 2018 municipal polygons. General-city districts in provinces are dissolved to city boundaries; metropolitan districts remain terminal. All original region codes are retained as legacy aliases.

restAreas.processing: Extract factual names, route numbers, directions and WGS84 latitude/longitude; no invented coordinates
restAreas.limitations: Third-party snapshot; original survey date and comprehensive coverage are not documented. Not a direct live Korea Expressway Corporation feed.

display.grouping: Same base name and route; direction suffix ignored. One original coordinate represents each group; every original ID remains a record alias.
